title: ESP32 IoT Automation Node
summary: A Wi-Fi connected sensor/actuator node built around the ESP32 for remote monitoring and control.
problem: Needed a compact, reliable node to monitor sensor data and drive an actuator remotely without a dedicated gateway device.
solution: Built firmware around the ESP32's built-in Wi-Fi, publishing sensor readings and accepting commands over MQTT for lightweight, low-latency remote control.
